Thought: SMILES notation "C" represents methane (CH4). Methane has a tetrahedral structure with a carbon atom at the center and four hydrogen atoms at the vertices of a tetrahedron. I need to identify the point group of this molecule based on its symmetry elements.

Methane (CH4) has:
- 4 C3 axes (through each C-H bond)
- 3 C2 axes (through the midpoints of opposite edges)
- 6 reflection planes
- A center of inversion

This combination of symmetry elements corresponds to the tetrahedral point group, which is Td.

Looking at the options, Td is listed as option D.
Final Answer: The molecule with SMILES notation "C" represents methane (CH4), which has a tetrahedral geometry. The carbon atom is at the center with four hydrogen atoms arranged at the vertices of a tetrahedron. This molecular structure belongs to the Td point group due to its high symmetry, including multiple C3 and C2 rotation axes and reflection planes.
